Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan promise not to build, expressly binding successors who take with notice, is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude rather than as a traditional negative easement.

Q5623.reason: The commentary is opinion about a public protest and a public figure, so the newsworthiness/public-interest privilege defeats an invasion-of-privacy claim; ill will is not actual malice and does not make the professor prevail.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest to afterborn children who reach 25 upon a church use that may occur at any time is void under the common-law RAP, so the friend holds fee simple absolute.
